_note: Team catalog, not the opencode runtime: opencode only reads the mcp key in opencode.json. Core = always on. Extras = delimited here and off (enabled false) until their trigger or the task asks for them.

engram.where: opencode.json in the repo (overrides the global entry) + binary per machine

github.where: no MCP: gh CLI via scripts/setup.sh
github.credential: GitHub account with the project scope, no extra token

drive.where: opencode.json in the repo (no secret) + OAuth per machine in .env
drive.credential: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET, GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN in .env (provided by the lead)
drive.rule: read-only and export; creating, uploading or deleting is forbidden

angular-cli.note: Official from the CLI (verified at angular.dev/ai/mcp and in the installed CLI 22.2.1). Read-only, no network; bump the pin together with the CLI. Opt-in like the rest

postgres.note: Exposes full SQL: the hard rules of HERRAMIENTAS-AGENTE.md §8 apply. {env:} resolves against the shell that launches opencode: export it first with set -a, source .env, set +a

redis.note: Official from Redis. Requires uvx (Python) per machine. When enabled, adjust the URL to the machine's REDIS_PORT

playwright.trigger: K1 prototypes or a task that asks for visual/E2E verification
playwright.use: viewport and specific selectors; evidence for the Definition of Done
playwright.optIn: enabled true in your global config, or an uncommitted local change

firecrawl.trigger: a milestone that needs systematic collection (dataset, OCR comparison) with the lead's authorization
firecrawl.use: search first, then scrape specific URLs; never bulk
firecrawl.optIn: enabled true in your global config, or an uncommitted local change
